SELECT t1.id, t1.title, t1.type, t1.path, t1.scope, t1.create_time, t2.read_time IS NOT NULL AS isRead, t2.read_time AS readTime FROM sys_message AS t1 LEFT JOIN sys_message_log AS t2 ON t2.message_id = t1.id AND t2.user_id = #{query.userId} WHERE t1.deleted = 0
AND COALESCE(t2.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE
AND t1.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.title}, '%')
AND t1.type = #{query.type}
AND t2.read_time IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY t1.create_time DESC

SELECT t1.id, t1.title, t1.content, t1.type, t1.path, t1.scope, t1.users, t1.create_time FROM sys_message AS t1 LEFT JOIN sys_message_log AS t2 ON t2.message_id = t1.id AND t2.user_id = #{userId} WHERE t1.deleted = 0 AND t1.id = #{id} AND COALESCE(t2.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE

SELECT t1.id FROM sys_message AS t1 LEFT JOIN sys_message_log AS t2 ON t2.message_id = t1.id AND t2.user_id = #{userId} WHERE t1.deleted = 0
AND COALESCE(t2.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE AND t2.read_time IS NULL
AND t1.id IN #{id}
ORDER BY t1.id

SELECT t1.type, COUNT(1) AS count FROM sys_message AS t1 LEFT JOIN sys_message_log AS t2 ON t2.message_id = t1.id AND t2.user_id = #{userId} WHERE t1.deleted = 0
AND COALESCE(t2.is_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE AND t2.read_time IS NULL GROUP BY t1.type

SELECT t1.id FROM sys_message AS t1 WHERE t1.deleted = 0
AND t1.id IN #{id}
